# Donadomains MCP, Full Reference

> Free MCP server. Domain search, WHOIS, and AI valuation for AI agents.

Connect URL: https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp
Web docs: https://www.donadomains.xyz/docs
Source: https://github.com/adipundir/donadomains

Auth: None. No signup, no API key. Rate-limited per IP (see below).
Transport: Streamable HTTP.

## Install

### Claude Code CLI

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http donadomains https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp
```

### Any other MCP client

Add this to your client's MCP server config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "donadomains": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Common config-file locations:
- Claude Desktop (macOS): `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
- Claude Desktop (Windows): `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
- Cursor: Settings, MCP
- Claude.ai web: Settings, Connectors, Add custom

## Tools

### Tool 1: check_domain_availability

Check if a specific domain is available for registration right now.

#### Input

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| domain | string | Yes | Fully qualified domain, e.g. "example.com" or "ad402.sh". |

#### Returns

If available:
- `domain` (string)
- `available` (true)
- `bestPrice` (string, e.g. "$9.99/yr")
- `bestPriceNumeric` (number)
- `bestRegistrar` (string)
- `buyUrl` (string)
- `allOffers` (array of {registrar, price, priceNum, url, isCheapest})

If taken:
- `domain` (string)
- `available` (false)
- `owner` (object): registrar, registrant, organization, created, expires, updated, nameservers, status, dnssec, dataSources

### Tool 2: search_domains

Search a keyword across 6 registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun) in parallel. Returns available domains with prices.

#### Input

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| keyword | string | Yes | Bare word ("startup") or full domain ("startup.io"). |
| limit | number | No | Max results (default 20, max 50). |
| tldFilter | string | No | Only return this TLD, e.g. ".com". |
| includeTaken | boolean | No | Include taken domains (default false). |

#### Returns

- `keyword` (string)
- `totalFound` (number)
- `returned` (number)
- `results` (array): each {domain, available, tld, matchType, bestPrice, bestPriceNumeric, bestRegistrar, buyUrl, allOffers}
- `registrarStatus` (array): per-registrar {name, status, count, durationMs, error?}

### Tool 3: get_domain_info

Deep WHOIS, RDAP, DNS intelligence for a registered domain. Layered pipeline:

1. RDAP for TLDs that publish one.
2. Port-43 WHOIS for RDAP-less ccTLDs (.sh, .io, .ac, .ws, .nu, .to).
3. DNS-over-HTTPS for nameservers and resolution.
4. who.is scrape as last-resort fallback.

Postgres-cached with adaptive TTLs (24h registered, 1h unregistered, 5min errors). Repeat lookups sub-100ms.

#### Input

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| domain | string | Yes | Fully qualified domain, e.g. "github.com". |

#### Returns

DomainIntel object:

- `domain` (string)
- `registered` (boolean)
- `status` (string[])
- `created`, `updated`, `expires` (ISO 8601 strings)
- `registrar`, `registrarUrl` (string)
- `registrant`, `organization` (string, often "REDACTED FOR PRIVACY")
- `contactEmail`, `contactPhone`, `contactAddress` (string, if not privacy-protected)
- `nameservers` (string[])
- `dnssec` (string)
- `sources` (string[]): any of "rdap", "whois43", "dns", "who.is"
- `timing` (object): ms per source
- `fetchedAt` (ISO string): last fresh fetch

### Tool 4: valuate_domain

AI-powered domain valuation using Google Gemini 2.0 Flash. Live registration intel is pulled into the model context. Results are cached in Postgres forever. First call hits Gemini, repeat calls are free and instant.

#### Input

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| domain | string | Yes | Domain to value, e.g. "crypto.com". |
| registered | boolean | No | Skip the registration lookup if you already know. |
| isPremium | boolean | No | Flag as registrar-premium (anchors valuation up). |
| registrationPrice | number | No | Current registration price in USD, if known. |

#### Returns

- `domain` (string)
- `score` (number, 0-100)
- `tier` ("common" | "decent" | "premium" | "ultra")
- `estimatedValue` (string, e.g. "$500 - $2,000")
- `reasoning` (string, 2-3 sentences)
- `factors` (array of {label, impact, detail}), 3-6 entries
- `cached` (boolean): true if served from cache

## Rate Limits

Free, unauthenticated, per source IP. IPv6 addresses are counted by their /64 prefix (so attackers can't rotate the lower 64 bits to bypass).

| Bucket | Limit | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Overall MCP calls | 200 / hour | Catch-all per IP. |
| check_domain_availability | 60 / hour | Cached, light. Shares bucket with get_domain_info. |
| get_domain_info | 60 / hour | Cached, light. |
| search_domains | 20 / hour | Scrapes 6 registrars. |
| valuate_domain | 20 / hour | Gemini on cache miss. Repeats are free. |

Windows are rolling-hour, starting from your first request. Exceeding a bucket returns the error inside a tool-result content block. Repeat lookups of the same domain hit the Postgres cache (about 50ms) and don't burn quota beyond the first call.

## Example prompts

- "Is ad402.sh available?"
- "Find me a cheap .io domain for a craft-beer brand under $20/yr."
- "Who owns github.com and when does it expire?"
- "What is crypto.com worth?"
- "Check who owns these 5 domains: github.com, openai.com, anthropic.com, cloudflare.com, stripe.com."

## How the pipeline works

When `get_domain_info` or `check_domain_availability` is called:

1. Postgres cache is checked. If fresh, returned in about 50ms.
2. On miss, in parallel:
   - DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare) for nameservers and resolution status.
   - RDAP if the TLD has an IANA-registered RDAP server.
   - WHOIS port-43 otherwise (or as fallback if RDAP returns sparse data).
3. If domain is registered but registrar or dates are still missing, Firecrawl scrapes who.is as last resort.
4. Result is written to cache with adaptive TTL:
   - Full data, registered: 24h.
   - Partial data, registered: 6h.
   - Unregistered: 1h.
   - Pending-delete or near-expiry: 1h.
   - Error: 5min.

When `search_domains` is called, all 6 registrar search pages are scraped in parallel via Firecrawl. Pricing is merged and the cheapest option marked `isCheapest: true`.

## Troubleshooting

- Rate limit exceeded: wait for the rolling-hour window to reset, or reduce call frequency.
- Slow first search: `search_domains` cold takes 5-15s. Cached subsequent reads are fast.
- Higher limits: open an issue at https://github.com/adipundir/donadomains/issues.
- Client only supports stdio: upgrade to a current version that supports the Streamable HTTP transport. A stdio-transport package is on the roadmap but not yet shipped.
